title: Kash Patel PANICS After Senator Cory Booker EXPOSES Her In Explosive Hearing#PamBondi#JeffreyEpstein
description:
#PamBondi #CongressHearing #JeffreyEpstein
BREAKING NEWS: A fiery exchange erupted during a congressional hearing as Senator Cory Booker grilled FBI Director Kash Patel over significant changes within the bureau and growing national security concerns.

Booker questioned Patel about reports that experienced FBI officials and senior agents were being pushed out, while thousands of agents were reassigned from critical investigations to immigration enforcement. He highlighted worries that personnel who previously handled terrorism, human trafficking, and child exploitation cases were being diverted from their core missions.

The confrontation escalated as Booker accused current FBI leadership of weakening institutional knowledge and undermining long-standing task forces focused on foreign interference, public corruption, and national security threats. He warned that these shifts could leave the U.S. vulnerable to both domestic and international dangers.

Patel strongly defended his leadership, citing enforcement successes, including arrests of violent criminals, seizures of illegal weapons and narcotics, and operations targeting human traffickers and child predators.
